Keep an upload zone showing the file the dataset already holds

Source: R/wizard-reference_estimates.R
push_upload_on_remount.Rd

Sets up, inside a module server, an observer that puts a file upload zone back in its "uploaded" state each time the zone appears on the page, when the dataset holds something the user uploaded for the zone's field (cache()$is_default(field) is FALSE). The zone shows the name of the file uploaded in this session, or a general "file on record" label when the name is not known (for example after loading a saved dataset).

Usage

push_upload_on_remount(
  input,
  session,
  i18n,
  input_id,
  field,
  cache,
  filename_val
)

Arguments

input, session

The input and session objects of the calling module server.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for the label shown when the file's name is not known.

input_id

The input id of the upload zone, without the namespace, a string.

field

The name of the dataset field the zone fills, a string (for example "un_estimates"), as cache()$is_default() takes it.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

filename_val

A reactive value (reactiveVal()) that holds the name of the file uploaded in this session, or NULL. The caller sets it after an upload and sets it to NULL when the zone is reset.

Value

Nothing useful. The function is called for its side effect of registering the observer.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a module's ui: the upload zone
cd_file_upload(ns("un_data"), label = "title_upload_un_estimates", accept = ".dta", i18n = i18n)

# in its server: remember the uploaded file's name, and show it when the zone comes back
un_filename <- reactiveVal(NULL)
observeEvent(input$un_data, un_filename(input$un_data$name))
observeEvent(input$un_data_reset, un_filename(NULL))
push_upload_on_remount(input, session, i18n, "un_data", "un_estimates", cache, un_filename)
} # }
